newsitem.title: FRANCE: Roussel-Uclaf says no decision on buy-out.
newsitem.headline: Roussel-Uclaf says no decision on buy-out.

text.p: The finance director of Roussel-Uclaf, Daniel Camus, said on Thursday that no decision had been taken about a buy-out of minorities as part of a merger into Hoechst-Marion-Roussell (HMR).
Germany's Hoechst has a 56.51 percent stake in the French pharmaceutical group and is planning to group all its drugs activities in HMR and give the unit a seperate listing.
"In the framework of the creation of HMR, we have to consider the matter of the minorities in Roussel-Uclaf, but no decision has been taken," Camus told Reuters.
Shares in Roussel-Uclaf gained on Thursday an a report in the La Vie Francaise weekly that Hoescht would make a buy-out at a possible 1,600.
At 1129 GMT, Roussel was 1.5 percent higher at 1,348.
